summary: The implementation preserves technical-valid tracks as the primary specimen-level population, keeps morphology warnings non-exclusionary, and reconciles reconstructed versus technical-valid counts. Acceptance is conditional because the retained evidence does not independently bind the below-2-um sensitivity table to the reviewed report package, and RC6 report metadata references RC5 artifacts.

evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:7308-7332 exports one technical-valid primary population and states that morphology warnings remain included.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3550-3565 records below_2_um technical review status without making length alone a technical veto.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:20-27 states that short, long, wide, curved, irregular, and single-slice nuclei remain measurable morphology.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:27-32 states that sub-2-um observations remain eligible for cross-slice joining.
tests/test_saturn_v571_dual_head.py::test_short_terminal_observation_can_bridge_one_missing_plane verifies short terminal observations can remain linked across a missing plane.
tests/test_saturn_v571_audit_blockers.py::test_gapped_track_records_missing_slice_without_volume_interpolation verifies missing-slice provenance is retained.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13612-13648 computes automated per-specimen below-2-um counts, fractions, and primary-versus-sensitivity medians.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json:2-21 declares biological_specimen as the analysis unit and inference_performed=false.
The retained artifact preserves 35 ledger specimens, 2 included specimens, and 33 excluded or missing specimens.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_source_binding.json:records reports all_counts_reconciled=true and retained_replay_archive_verified=true.
The same binding records KJ all_reconstructed_tracks=5766 and technical_valid_tracks=5517, and WT all_reconstructed_tracks=3541 and technical_valid_tracks=3423.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json reports technical exclusion fractions and width missingness while retaining excluded specimens.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13640-13647 labels the below-2-um output as automated sensitivity and states that short tracks remain in the primary biological population.

No retained file under audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report independently provides the generated below_2_um_specimen_sensitivity.csv named by sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13649, so the below-2-um sensitivity result is not directly artifact-bound.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_metadata.json:16-19 and 34-36 reference RC5 rather than RC6 artifacts.

findings.title: Below-2-um sensitivity output is not independently retained and bound to the reviewed package
findings.impact: The code defines the correct specimen-level sensitivity estimand, but the acceptance evidence does not establish that the below-2-um counts and morphometry changes were generated for and delivered with the reviewed candidate.
evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13612-13649 defines and writes below_2_um_specimen_sensitivity.csv.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data contains specimen_sensitivity_artifact.csv and specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json, but no below_2_um_specimen_sensitivity.csv.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_source_binding.json asserts count reconciliation but does not list a retained below-2-um sensitivity artifact.
findings.recommendation: Retain the generated below_2_um_specimen_sensitivity.csv or an equivalent content-addressed JSON artifact, bind it in report metadata, and independently verify denominators, below-2-um fractions, primary and sensitivity medians, and excluded-specimen handling.

findings.title: Report metadata references a prior candidate
findings.impact: Consumers cannot determine whether the displayed population and sensitivity reporting correspond to the reviewed commit and evidence package.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_metadata.json:16-19 references v571_rc5_candidate biological artifacts.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_metadata.json:34-36 references v571_rc5_candidate quality-control artifacts.
audits/runs/20260827-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc6/reviews/statistics_reporting.json records this as a blocking report provenance defect.
findings.recommendation: Correct the report metadata and consistency validation, retain the below-2-um sensitivity output, and obtain an independent specimen-level reconciliation review.

limitations: No full image-stack execution was performed.
The retained replay contains one representative specimen per group; inferential statistics are appropriately unavailable.
This review evaluates estimands, denominators, missingness, and report selection, not biological validity or tracking geometry.
recommended_follow_up: Create a superseding audit package with content-addressed below-2-um sensitivity output and corrected report metadata.
Rerun the focused short-track, specimen-sensitivity, report-field-selection, and reconciliation tests in the declared test environment.
